test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 29 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The minimum strength of the Council of Ministers in a state as per the Indian Constitution is ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**12 persons**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Minimum Strength:** The Council must have at least **12 ministers**, including the Chief Minister.
 
• It must constitute at least **10%** of the state's Legislative Assembly. 
 
• **Maximum Strength:** It cannot exceed **15%** of the total Assembly strength.
 
• This rule was introduced by the **91st **Constitutional Amendment** Act, 2003. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **91st Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003**:

 
 
• **Limit on Ministers:** The Council of Ministers cannot exceed **15%** of the total strength of the **legislative body,** but must have at least **12 ministers.**
 
• **Anti-Defection**: Strengthened the anti-defection law,** disqualifying MPs/ML**As who defect from holding ministerial positions.
 
• **No Exemption for Splits:** Removed the provision allowing splits in parties by **one-third of members.**
 
• **Disqualification: **Defectors **cannot be appointed** to ministerial or remunerative political positions **until re-elected**.
 
• The **Council of Ministers **is collectively responsible to the **Legislative Assembly**, meaning they must maintain the **confidence of the majority** to remain in power.
 
• Each minister is responsible for their own actions and for the administration of their department.
 
• Ministers are required to take an **oath of office and secrecy** before assuming their duties,** administered by the Governor.**
